sources.title: [2603.22570] CanViT: Toward Active-Vision Foundation Models
sources.snippet: Active computer vision promises efficient, biologically plausible perception through sequential, localized glimpses, but lacks scalable general-purpose architectures and pretraining pipelines, leaving Active-Vision Foundation Models (AVFMs) underexplored. We introduce CanViT, the first task- and policy-agnostic AVFM. CanViT uses scene-relative RoPE to bind a retinotopic Vision Transformer ...
